entities.name: Józef Baka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Józef Baka was a late Baroque Polish poet, Jesuit priest and missionary. Born in March of either 1706 or 1707, probably in Nowogrodek, Baka is regarded as one of the most prominent poets of the 18th century Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
